$comment: The pinned vcpkg baseline. This commit -- not whatever the local clone happens to be
checked out at -- decides which version of every dependency resolves. That is what makes
the build reproducible: `git pull` in the vcpkg clone changes nothing here, and updating
dependencies is an edit to this file, visible in a diff and attributable to a person.
overlay-ports is where a dependency goes when vcpkg lacks a serviceable port ON THE
x64-mingw-dynamic TRIPLET -- which is a community triplet, and is exactly the question
risk A5 asks. A port that builds only under MSVC becomes an overlay here, never a reason
